name: Twenty-Two
description: Twenty-Two (also known as 22) is a trick-taking card game where the winner of the last trick is penalised. Players try to avoid taking the final trick; the losing card is kept as penalty points (Aces 11, face cards 10, others face value). First player to reach 22 or more points is eliminated; last player remaining wins. Suits are irrelevant; cards rank A-K-Q-J-10-9-8-7-6-5-4-3-2.

This version of 22 comes from North America but is based on the Icelandic version of the Nordic game Cucumber.
2-6 (one 52-card pack). With more than six players, combine packs (one pack per four players).
Standard 52-card Anglo-American pack without jokers. Suits irrelevant; rank A (high) to 2 (low).

First dealer: highest card draw (repeat if tie). First hand: seven cards each, one at a time, clockwise. Subsequently the loser of each hand deals; number of cards dealt = value of loser's scoring card from the hand just ended (e.g. queen = 10 cards each). If insufficient cards, deal equally until fewer cards left than players.
